subject: math
objective: List all factors of a whole number from 2 to 100 by testing candidates in order and pairing each factor with its partner, and explain why the search can stop when the doors meet.
modelLimitations: Following the method exactly, the doors close only when they meet a factor pair, so prime numbers require testing many candidates; an optional square-root shortcut puzzle is offered.
Finds the factors of one number; does not yet compare two numbers for common factors.
